name: The Grove
description: The Grove is Los Angeles' premier open-air shopping, dining, and entertainment destination featuring a sophisticated mix of retailers, restaurants, and an AMC movie theater. Set in a beautifully landscaped environment with iconic features like a historic double-decker trolley and dancing fountain, The Grove offers an upscale lifestyle experience in the heart of LA. This Caruso-managed property combines Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle with year-round events, family-friendly amenities, and a vibrant atmosphere.
summary: Los Angeles' favorite open-air lifestyle destination offering upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment in a vibrant, family-friendly environment.
